prompt: I have react app. I want to use Free Dictionary API to search words and get display information about them on my page. I have input and place to display information. I just want to request this API and get data. How to code API request and then handle the query?
response: To use the Free Dictionary API in your React app, you can make a GET request to the API endpoint using the `fetch` function. You should include the word you want to search as a query parameter in the URL. Once you receive the response, you can parse the JSON data and extract the relevant information to display on your page. Make sure to handle any errors that may occur during the request.
